summary: The temporal worker deployment set-current-version CLI command cannot switch to unversioned mode in the default namespace, failing with 'BuildID cannot be empty' error, which blocks the official cleanup flow for accidental worker deployment metadata.
userImpact: Users cannot properly clean up accidental worker deployment metadata using standard commands, forcing them to manually delete internal workflows.
rootCause: The CLI validation logic requires a non-empty BuildID even when the --unversioned flag is specified, preventing the command from accepting unversioned mode.
proposedFix: Modify the CLI validation to allow --unversioned or --build-id "" to switch current version to unversioned without requiring a non-empty BuildID.
workaround: Force-clean by terminating and deleting the internal worker deployment entity workflows using workflow-id targeting.
keyQuote: --unversioned or --build-id "" should switch current version to unversioned, so delete-version and delete deployment can proceed.
